attempts.summary: Configured policy-based egress steering so node3's TCP/8080 traffic to node4 traverses transit network 1 (node1 eth1 10.10.1.0/24 to node2 vtnet1), and TCP/9090 traverses transit network 2 (node1 eth2 10.10.2.0/24 to node2 vtnet2), both delivered to node4 via node2's dedicated access link (vtnet3/enp8s0, 10.10.24.0/24). Discovered the real topology empirically since node1 has 3 extra NICs, node2 has 3, node3/node4 each have 1 dedicated link. Implemented via VyOS policy-route (PBR-PORT ruleset bound to eth3, tables 100/200 with per-port next-hops) on node1, and OPNsense OPT interface assignment plus pf pass rules plus static return route on node2. Verified with tcpdump captures showing each port's SYN exclusively on its designated transit interface and socat end-to-end delivery to node4. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all 4 nodes, capturing pre/post boot-identity changes and confirming full recovery, including fixing a NetworkManager autoconnect=no issue on node3/node4's dedicated interfaces (found during node3's restart, fixed proactively on node4 before its restart). Final end-to-end test after all 4 restarts reconfirmed correct per-port transit steering and delivery.
